summary: Imagine, build and customize your own world in a fun open-ended creative game
description:
IMAGINE YOUR CITY… AND BRING IT TO LIFE!
Draw your roads, lay your rails, place your buildings and create a city just the way you like it: small houses, tall buildings, parks, shops, monuments… Here, everything begins with a simple swipe of a finger.

Place Pango and friends in their roles: firefighter, mail carrier, doctor, shopkeeper… They drive, work, visit, wander around, go home to sleep at night… and bring life to everything you create. Every street becomes a story, every district an adventure.

Pango Build City is an open-ended construction game that develops creativity, organisation, exploration and fine motor skills. An intuitive, open experience perfectly suited for children aged 3 and up.

A PANGO CREATION
With over 15 years of experience and more than 15 million children worldwide, Pango is a trusted name for parents looking for calm, intelligent and gentle games.
Pango Build City continues this philosophy: a lively building game designed to spark creativity, logic and the pride of creating.

WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO BUILD CITY
- Boosts imagination and sense of organisation
- Builds logic and understanding of how a city works
- Strengthens fine motor skills through road and rail placement
- 100% open construction: children create, modify and expand their city freely
- A gentle, lively world with no stress or competition
- Simple, smooth and perfectly adapted to small hands
- 3 pre-built cities to support younger children

A 100% CHILD-SAFE GAME
• No in-app purchases  
• No advertising  
• No external links  
• Built-in parental controls  
• Complies with children’s data protection standards  

THE PANGO VALUES: CREATIVITY, AUTONOMY, KINDNESS
At Pango, we design experiences from a child’s perspective: simple, open and enriching. Our games nurture curiosity, encourage independence and let every child imagine their own world.

Need help? A question? pango@studio-pango.com
